vBRIEFInfo.description: Report generation: terminal output, markdown reports, JSON export

plan.title: Report Generation
plan.narrative: Implement output formatting: Rich terminal display with color-coded severity sections, full markdown report saved to reports/manuscript_name_YYYY-MM-DD.md with inline chapter/line references, and JSON output via --format json for scripting and Autonomicon integration. Optional example rewrites via --show-rewrites. Traces: FR-18, FR-19, FR-20, FR-22.

items.title: Rich terminal output
items.narrative: Color-coded display with collapsible sections per dimension. Severity-based coloring (green=strength, yellow=neutral, red=concern). FR-18.

items.title: Markdown report writer
items.narrative: Full report saved as markdown with inline chapter/line references, executive summary at top, per-dimension sections. FR-19.

items.title: JSON export
items.narrative: Structured JSON output matching the internal analysis model for scripting and Autonomicon integration. FR-20.

items.title: Optional rewrites
items.narrative: When --show-rewrites is passed, include 'one possible alternative' passages. Framed as suggestions, not corrections. FR-22.
